# Policymaker #243 — iteration 0032

## What changed and why
- Re-review #241 (iteration 0031) returned **revise** at main f913eb8 with one Spec finding. Derivable extra claims are scored in `extra_outcome()` (`benchmark/scripts/score.py:77-98`, called at :137-142), which skips the condition policy that required claims get at :166-179. Adding `Native runtime dependency resolved successfully.` to `X-true` still scores correct and leaves the condition ledger empty, which goes against `benchmark/protocol.md:29,35-36`. Standards were clean, and regenerating the results was byte-identical. Evidence: release artifact `iter-0031/241-condition-review.md`.
- I checked this myself. The only derivable extras are X-false and X-true (twice) in `library-icon-tests.json`. All of them match key A0005 and carry the same conditions, so a fix should keep all 33 of 33 controls matching.
- I ordered `extra-claim-conditions` (benchmark, medium effort, 45 min/30 turns, from main). It makes extras and required claims use one shared condition helper and adds a sixth built-in regression mutation (the #241 reproduction).
  **Expected gain:** the last open scorer finding is closed, so the scorer and results can be re-reviewed and then pinned under the challenges milestone.
  **Check:** `score.py --check` exits 0, totals stay 33/33/0/0, and `regression_self_test` has six entries, with the extra-claim mutation producing a non-empty ledger.
- I updated `policy/working-memory.md` with the 0032 section.
- There is still no benchmark readiness. The scorer results are development-only, and these remain missing: split (not started), native evidence (#169 waiting), typedef-impact and diagram-difference development cases, and the owner's acceptance of the method.

## Discoveries
- Reviewer sessions requested with the `opus` alias went to codex gpt-6.1-sol for the third time (#221, #232, #241). The author was also codex, so this review again had no model-family diversity (#241 `models` block, 640k codex input).

## What next
- Next Policymaker: read the fix report, then order one narrow re-review from main covering finding 1 plus a spot check. Its Verification must not read `.session/report.md`.
- This is fix round 2 of `fix_rounds` 2. If the review says revise again, re-scope the work instead of ordering a third fix.
- After an accept, pin the scorer and results with an idempotent landing script run once.
- Don't redo the #232/#241 accounting and mutation checks.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
